invoice_number.description: The invoice's number; a draft has none.

missing_particulars.description: Those the rendered document lacks, such as the organisation's address when its profile has none; empty when none is missing.

items.description: An IRAS particular, such as supplier_gst_number, total_with_gst or reason.

pdf.description: The document, as PDF/A-2a and PDF/UA-1, base64.

required_particulars.description: The IRAS particulars it must show (FR-AR-05); none before the organisation is GST-registered. A draft leaves out number: it takes one when it is issued.

items.description: An IRAS particular, such as supplier_gst_number, total_with_gst or reason.

sha256.description: The PDF's SHA-256, in hex: the same version and template always give the same bytes.

simplified.description: Whether it is a simplified tax invoice: sales.simplified_tax_invoices is on and its total with GST is at most S$1,000.00.

tax_invoice.description: Whether it is a tax invoice: the organisation is GST-registered on its date.

template.description: The template version it rendered with: the customer's, the organisation's default, or the platform's starter.
